answer: Courier nonce ledger: each new agent identity must redeem a one-use quill code delivered by courier to a verified address, with the ledger rejecting a second code for that address in the epoch. Attacker cost is one real courier visit and address control per identity; even a remote oasis address must be serviced, and reused addresses freeze pending codes. An anchor record binds the redeemed code to the agent’s first signed action, so copying the code invalidates both.
